Hi, I’d like to work on issue #564 (AutomorphicForm/QuaternionAlgebra/Defs is slow).

I took a look at the issue and I want to investigate whether the slowdown comes from the RestrictedProduct ring instance shape, in particular the use of DFunLike.coe_injective.ring, and whether a cheaper definition helps this file and possibly other adele-ring files too.

The issue does not seem to be on the project board yet. Could someone add it so I can claim it through the usual workflow?

Kevin Buzzard said:

FLT#564

I just tried claim, but GitHub still says issue #564 is not on the project board yet. The issue sidebar also shows “Projects: No projects”. Could someone add it to the project board?

Feel free to investigate this issue and don't worry about claiming anything. By the way, are you someone who knows nothing about Lean but has access to an LLM? If so then don't expect any changes you make to be merged (unless they are very minimal and obviously sensible).
@Kevin Buzzard Thank you Kevin. I know Lean, and I will prove it.

OK nice! My first instinct would be to check that the issue still exists; there have been an absolute ton of changes to Lean since the issue was opened. I am in the process of doing this myself -- I'm really sorry, but the build is currently failing because of warnings which our automation has failed to spot (the last merged PR was from a bot and the bot was supposed to have checked it worked) and which I'm currently fixing.
@Kevin Buzzard No worry Kevin. I think I got some nice thoughts on it and will try to tackle that. Will let you know if I get progress. :)

@Kevin Buzzard Hi Kevin, I opened a draft PR for the local Defs.lean part of #564:
https://github.com/ImperialCollegeLondon/FLT/pull/988

The patch only reduce about 30% of the total time. If we want to continue to dig in, we probabably need a separate split of the finite-adele API/import boundary. If you agree, I can continue to dig in it.
